# @surfaces-ui/embedder-local

Local embedding model for semantic search; the model is downloaded on first use to a cache outside the repo.

A small embedding model run on your machine for semantic search. The model downloads on first use to a cache outside your project.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/embedder-local
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
